name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA)
description: Common Paper standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, allowing two parties to exchange confidential information under mutual confidentiality obligations.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) Cover Page
description: Cover page used to execute the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement by incorporating the Standard Terms and capturing the parties' deal-specific details.

name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement granting an early customer access to a product in exchange for feedback during a design partner program.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement, designed to be used with the Cloud Service Agreement, covering uptime commitments, response times, and service credits.

name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement for engaging a services provider to perform work under one or more statements of work.

name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement governing the processing of personal data between a data controller and a data processor.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing on-premise or self-hosted software.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for structuring a business partnership between two companies.

name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement for HIPAA-covered entities and their business associates handling protected health information.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement, a short-term contract allowing a prospective customer to test a product or service before committing to a longer-term deal.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum, supplementing a Software License Agreement or Cloud Service Agreement with terms governing the use of artificial intelligence features.
